The "'''Creepy Crate Guy'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He made masks during [[Halloween/Legends|Halloween]] and gave them out in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==Behind the scenes==
The "Creepy Crate Guy" first appeared in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] during the Halloween event.
